item.description:
I am a Senior Research Scientist at Google Deepmind, co-building the Gemini family of language models. I spend most of my time establishing the core mechanics of LLM pre-training: data, evals, and scaling behavior, and how these three elements connect across the world’s languages. Previously, I drove research-to-production systems for Google Translate.

I completed my Ph.D. in Computer Science at the University of Maryland, College Park, where I was a member of the Computational Linguistics and Information Processing (CLIP) lab. My dissertation on detecting fine-grained semantic divergences to improve translation understanding won the Best Thesis Award from the Association for Machine Translation in the Americas, where I now serve as a Research Director.

While much of my current research remains internal to Google, my public contributions are available in my google scholar or in tech reports (e.g. Gemini 2, 2.5, and 3.0).
